subject: Quick architecture triage before demo
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@retailx.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 15m architecture triage before full demo

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick follow-up after our self-serve signup. Before we book a full demo I wanted to do a short technical check (15 minutes) with our infra lead to confirm a couple of constraints:

- Data residency options (we have EU and US tenants)
- On-prem/private deployment feasibility and rough timelines
- Typical latency numbers at 99th percentile for 1k token requests

Would one of the following windows work for a short call this week?
- Thu 9/16 10:00-10:15 PT
- Thu 9/16 15:00-15:15 PT
- Fri 9/17 08:30-08:45 PT

I can bring Ethan (infra architect) if that helps. Also can you confirm if you have a short checklist or network requirements PDF we can skim ahead of time?

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, RetailX
maya@retailx.com

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Maya Patel <maya@retailx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 15m architecture triage before full demo

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and for outlining the key items.

All three times look workable; I can hold Thu 9/16 10:00 PT and Thu 9/16 15:00 PT as first options (we're flexible). I looped in Marissa (AE) and Dev (solutions engineer) — Dev will lead the short triage.

Proposed agenda (15 mins):
1) Quick intros (1 min)
2) Confirm residency/on-prem constraints (6 min)
3) Latency/throughput expectations and reference numbers (5 min)
4) Next steps and handoff to full demo (3 min)

Attachments: RX-PreDemo-Checklist.pdf (application/pdf) — quick pre-read with network/SSO questions.

If you confirm the time and whether Ethan will join, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read link.

Best,
Markus Klein
SDR, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: Maya Patel <maya@retailx.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Ethan Crowley <ethan.c@retailx.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 15m architecture triage before full demo

Thanks Markus — Thu 9/16 10:00 PT works for us. Ethan will join.

A couple quick asks we hope to cover in the short call so Dev can prep:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Private deployments?
- Any summary of typical token-level costs for inference vs embeddings (ballpark) — fine if rough.
- If you have a short SSO/SCIM doc link that would speed internal approvals.

Ethan will also want to share one slide about our current infra layout (VPCs + transit).

See you then,
Maya

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Maya Patel <maya@retailx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 15m architecture triage before full demo

Great — 9/16 10:00 PT is locked. Calendar invite sent (link below) — please accept when you can.

Calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/evts/9d2a3 (adds to your calendar)
Pre-read: https://drive.reddemo.company/drive/folders/Redwood-PreDemo-Notes (contains RX-PreDemo-Checklist.pdf and network_requirements.docx)

Quick answers to help prep Dev:
- KMS/HSM: Yes — we support customer-managed keys for Private and can integrate with common HSM/KMS providers. We'll confirm specifics on the call.
- Cost: Ballpark inference token delta vs embedding varies by model; typical hosted text-gen is 0.8–2.0x per-token of a comparable embedding workload depending on model size and quantization. We can follow up with more concrete numbers after we know the target model/throughput.

Attachments included for your convenience: infra_diagram.pdf (image/pdf) — a one-page diagram of the typical VPC peering pattern we recommend.

See you on Thu — Dev will kick off.

Best,
Markus

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: Maya Patel <maya@retailx.com>, Ethan Crowley <ethan.c@retailx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 15m architecture triage before full demo

On Tue, Sep 14, 2027 at 10:45 AM markus_klein@redwood.ai wrote:
> Quick answers to help prep Dev:
> - KMS/HSM: Yes — we support customer-managed keys for Private and can integrate with common HSM/KMS providers.
> - Cost: Ballpark inference token delta vs embedding varies by model; typical hosted text-gen is 0.8–2.0x per-token of a comparable embedding workload depending on model size and quantization.

Hi Maya / Ethan — looking forward to the short session. I'll plan to:
- Spend ~4 minutes on deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) with focus on data residency and KMS workflows.
- Spend ~6 minutes on performance/latency: share 99th%-tile numbers from similar customers and what drives tail latency (batching, KV cache warm-up).
- Last ~5 mins: quick checklist for network egress, firewall rules, and SSO (SCIM) pointers.

If you can share Ethan's slide ahead of time (one slide), I can make sure we address any particular network/topology questions. Otherwise we'll cover at a high level and follow up with a tailored document.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
